list.name: Changes
list.comment: Very large update, I'll try and list everything I've done so far 1. Autocompletion with all dlls from Isle Goblin (any Unity dll and the code for Isle Goblin itself) all loaded from your own copy. (ISLE GOBLIN CODE IS NOT SHIPPED WITH THIS PRODUCT) 2. Custom theming (Resources/Themes) see the documentation for more info on making your own 3. Reopening last tab (holds multiple) 4. Decompiled files are stored for quick access in same session 5. Fixed folding to work with all kinds of syntax 6. Go to definition (works with decompiled tabs) 7. Opening files using middle mouse button 8. Fixed outer margins looking weird on fullscreen 9. Upgraded to Avalonia 12 (NOTE: CURRENT VERSION IS A 12.2 ALPHA, I REALLY NEEDED A CERTAIN FIX THAT WAS ONLY AVAIABLE ON THIS VERSION PLEASE UPDATE TO 12.2 ON RELEASE) 10. Main Menu Overhaul 11. New Documentation (Check wiki section in repo) 12. Added a recent projects section 13. anytime you see a mod for example open existing or in recent projects you can right click for a context menu that lets you configure, open in explorer, and delete mod. 14. Added a value for the level of opacity because I acknowledge that some people may not want the app to be translucent 15. Collapse, expand foldings, coment, and uncomment functions (with chorded keybinds) 16. Chorded keybinding along with a chorded menu item because Avalonia doesn't support chording natively 17. TONS of styling 18. Started work on an update service, accessible through main menu 19. Added some more keybinds 20. Added diagnostics (warnings, errors, and tips in the code editor) 21. Symbol/Diagnostic tooltips 22. Added autoclosing parentheses 23. Added keybinds to main menu 24. Added more icons 25. Added an option to run Isle Goblin in code editor (Its under File > Open Isle Goblin) 26. And more

task.summary: Added renaming files, fixed entire project closing on last tab closure, added splitter.
Added Quick Build with its respective settings and added a Overwrite Csproj button just in case

Made the file tree useful, added the following: create new files and folders withing the tree, rename anything, delete anything, open in explorer, and some QOL. Also started adding some icons. If there are too many or something doesn't feel right then it can be taken back
